label: fix 1b42e982 — directory file-drop never deletes files removed from source
summary: Fixed the destination-side half of the silent-staleness class: non-agent directory file-drops (skill/command/hook) now mirror the source exactly via a new mirrorPathSync helper (rmSync then cpSync), so a file removed from the source is pruned from the destination on re-install and upgrade. Replaced the merge copy at the primary file-drop branch and the skip-if-exists guard at the hook-script secondary drop.

changes.kind: added mirrorPathSync(src,dest) helper + used it in the primary file-drop branch (was fs.cpSync merge) and the hook-script secondary drop (was !existsSync skip + fs.cpSync merge), with a BUG-028 ownership guard on the hook-script path
new regression spec: a removed source file is absent from the destination after re-install, for skill, command, and hook (drives the real declarativeInstall)
updated the e1e98fe0 note to point at the new destination-side spec (no longer 'pre-existing defect')
